entities.name: PMID:27502250
observations: 2016 study of 240 type 2 diabetes patients with HbA1c ≤7% and no prior CVD; compared 72-hour CGM variability with Framingham-predicted 10-year CVD risk.

entities.name: CGM variability and FRS risk
observations: SDBG and MAGE increased across Framingham 10-year CVD risk strata (p<0.01); MAGE independently predicted high estimated risk (OR 1.623, 95% CI 1.198–2.316; p<0.001). This was predicted risk, not observed 10-year events.
